    The trace–reject criterion #

    Theorem 2.12 of the manuscript: for a quotient-closed T and a subobject-closed F, the pair (T, F) is a pretorsion theory iff for every object X

    • r(X) = r(t(X)) and
    • t(X / r(X)) = t(X) / r(X),

    where t = t_T is the trace and r = r_F the reject. In Lean the first equality is stated as r(X) ≤ t(X) together with r(t(X)) = mk (ofLE r(X) t(X)), the subobject of t(X) given by r(X); the second as t(X/r(X)) = image (t(X) → X → X/r(X)). When the condition holds, t(X)/r(X) lies in T ∩ F and t(X) → X → X/r(X) is short (T ∩ F)-preexact.

    Corollary 2.13 (Facchini–Finocchiaro–Gran): for a pretorsion theory (T, F) with Z = T ∩ F, F = {Y : t_T(Y) ∈ Z} and T = {X : X/r_F(X) ∈ Z}.

    structure PretorsionImageClosed.Statement.TraceRejectCondition {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] [HasLength C] (T F : Subcategory C) (X : C) :
    Prop

    The trace–reject condition (2.4) at an object X.

    • reject_le_trace : Subcategory.reject X F ≤ T.trace X

      r(X) ⊆ t(X).

    • reject_trace : Subcategory.reject (CategoryTheory.Subobject.underlying.obj (T.trace X)) F = CategoryTheory.Subobject.mk ((Subcategory.reject X F).ofLE (T.trace X) ⋯)

      r(t(X)) = r(X), as subobjects of t(X).

    • trace_cokernel : T.trace (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel (Subcategory.reject X F).arrow) = CategoryTheory.Limits.imageSubobject (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (T.trace X).arrow (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel.π (Subcategory.reject X F).arrow))

      t(X/r(X)) = t(X)/r(X), as subobjects of X/r(X).
